evidence: Nestled peacefully on the tranquil Đảo Ngọc Ngũ Xã, surrounded by the serene waters of Hồ Trúc Bạch, the Ngu Xa Traditional Bronze Casting Shop stands as a gleaming testament to Hanoi’s rich cultural heritage. Its origins trace back to the seventeenth century during the Lê Dynasty, when skilled artisans from the five renowned craft villages of Kinh Bắc—namely Đông Hồ, Phù Lỗ, Võng La, Thổ Hà, and Đồng Kiên—converged on this site, giving rise to the name “Ngũ Xa,” meaning “Five Villages.”
